name: Flexible Asset Allocation (momentum-tilted weights)
description: Multi-factor momentum strategy (Keller & van Putten, 2012) with enhanced momentum weighting. Ranks each asset on three factors: trailing return, realized volatility (low-vol favored), and average pairwise correlation to other assets (low-correlation favored). Uses momentum-heavy factor weights (1.5, 0.25, 0.25) to emphasize trailing return signal and selects top 3 assets. Applies absolute-momentum gate: drops any selected asset with negative trailing return and redirects weight to safe asset (bonds). Equal-weights survivors.
